title: deploy/state/clean/result.json (version 1)
description: The host's answer to the last clean request, written atomically by `synap clean-request` (or, when it died before answering, by deploy/request-outcome.sh with "by":"unit"). Read by the backend at /opt/synap/deploy/state/clean/result.json; match it to the request by id. Each answer also lands in state/events.jsonl as a `pod.clean` event.

id.description: The request's id; empty when the request carried no valid uuid.

action.description: The action asked for, as asked (a refused unknown action is echoed, cut at 64 characters).

freedBytes.description: Free space gained on Docker's data root, for the prune actions, when df could measure it.

by.description: Present only when the unit, not the engine, answered (the engine died before recording a result).
